name: code-philly-website
description: C.O.D.E (Community of Developers & Engineers) Philadelphia community website

scripts.generate:data: npm run generate:events && npm run generate:live-feeds
scripts.validate: npm run validate:events && npm run validate:frontmatter
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run generate:data && npm run prod:build -- --baseURL "/website-frontpage/" && npm run test:e2e
scripts.prod: npm run clean && npm run generate:data && npm run prod:build && npm run prod:local
scripts.start: npm run clean && npm run generate:data && npm run devserver
